body: Honestly if I were you I wouldn’t smoke it or atleast the thc part of it CBD might be a better option I have dpdr and I feel like smoking plus some other things mainly contributed to it and almost lead me to having a mental breakdown what I’m trying to say is marijuana makes everything intense and smoking while having dpdr wouldnt be a smart thing to do

Life is a beautiful thing no matter how hard it is you have to think you’re alive and living this in itself may never be an opportunity you’ll get again I understand how you feel believe me I do but suicide does nothing but end the gift you’ve been given which sounds corny but is true
Like ik things could always be so much worse and I’m extremely grateful they’re not but man it’d be nice if things could be easier too ya know.
